text:
Assistant A gives a short answer in a malformed format. Its keys are odd, such as "y, x, e, pi":1, and it is not valid JSON overall because it emits separate objects per line. It also includes constants (e, pi) and the function name comb as variables, and it misses N in equation 2 only partly (N is included). It omits the variable names in equation 1 correctly (y, x), but the extras are wrong. Even so, it is readable and roughly on target.

Assistant B is badly broken. It repeats entries in a degenerate loop, is truncated and invalid JSON, mixes numbers and function names in as variables, and merges equation 3 into equation 2. It is essentially unusable.

A is clearly better.

[[A]]
